title: INTRODUCTION TO ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOR
description: Diagnoses individual and small-group behavior and develops skills in improving individual and small-group performance in entrepreneurial and established ventures. Emphasizes professional skill development and the practical application of theory and research. Integrates concepts of ethics, diversity, and cross-cultural relations.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: COMM 111Z, 111HZ, 111, 111H, 114, 114H, 218Z, 218HZ, 218 or 218H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in COMM 111Z, COMM 111HZ, COMM 111, COMM 111H, COMM 114, COMM 114H, COMM 218Z, COMM 218HZ, COMM 218 and COMM 218H.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Apparel Design (400)
  • Pre-Apparel (453)
  • Pre-Interiors (454)
  • Interior Design (458)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Design & Innovation Management (912)
  • Product and Merchandising Mgmt (A014)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.

BA 251/252/351/352 are mutually exclusive. Mutual Exclusions Info.
